mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONF_RM) AS total_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.CONF_RM_ID) FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN r.BEGIN_DT AND r.END_DT ) AS in_use_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONF_RM rm WHERE rm.USE_YN = 'Y' AND rm.CONF_RM_ID NOT IN ( SELECT r.CONF_RM_ID FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN r.BEGIN_DT AND r.END_DT ) ) AS available_count, ( SELECT ROUND( AVG( ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM( (LEAST(r.END_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 18/24) - GREATEST(r.BEGIN_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 9/24)) * 24 * 60 ), 0) FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV r WHERE r.CONF_RM_ID = rm.CONF_RM_ID AND r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.BEGIN_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 18/24 AND r.END_DT > TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 9/24 ) / (9 * 60) * 100 ), 1 ) FROM TB_CONF_RM rm WHERE rm.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS avg_occupancy_rate FROM DUAL

SELECT rm.CONF_RM_ID, rm.CONF_RM_NM, rm.CONF_RM_FLR, rm.CONF_RM_HO, rm.CONF_RM_COLOR, rm.USE_YN, rm.CONF_RM_MNGR_ID, e.EMP_NM AS mngr_nm, d.DEPT_NM AS mngr_dept_nm, j.JOB_GRD_NM AS mngr_job_grd_nm, e.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS mngr_prfl_img_file_id FROM TB_CONF_RM rm LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE e ON rm.CONF_RM_MNGR_ID = e.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON e.DEPT_CD = d.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE j ON e.JOB_GRD_CD = j.JOB_GRD_CD ORDER BY rm.CONF_RM_FLR, rm.CONF_RM_HO
